title: Jamaican Avocado Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious bowl filled with Jamaican spices, avocado, and a hint of sweet glaze.
instructions: 1. Cook the brown rice according to package instructions.
2. In a pan, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
3. Add the Jamaican Jerk Seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
4. Add the chopped carrots and cook for 5 minutes, or until tender.
5. In a separate pan, grill the avocado slices until slightly charred.
6. In a bowl, combine the cooked rice, carrots, avocado slices, and chopped cilantro.
7. Drizzle with lime juice and serve.
